summary: Binance Wallet's Pokémon pack tease kept spreading, and one account mapped 16 onchain card gacha companies across 6 chains. A 52k-follower VC said Collector Crypt copycats have higher take rates and odds nobody can verify, which plays to Solflare Packs showing odds up front. Solflare Packs talk was all about the limited Charizard and Fire Friends pack, mostly from ambassadors and small accounts, with mostly positive tone. Collector chatter: Costco 30th Celebration restocks selling out in minutes, PSA vs TAG price gaps, Arena Club pausing buybacks until the new year, and packs feeling 'like the stock market'.
